method: Live browser actions, viewport screenshots, read-only DOM rectangle checks. Only saved states are measured; this is not a cumulative layout shift performance measurement. Native touch and pinch remain unverified.

offline.method: Cached production build, stopped its local HTTP server, independently confirmed HTTP requests failed, then reloaded and selected molecules.

limits: Physical touch/pinch and projector not tested
Some 3D labels overlap at certain views when multiple options are enabled
Small-screen disaccharide details use the enlargement dialog
